Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
1)I read that the vamp special ability can be used even if the vamp is in
torpor: is it true?
Can Mariel tap herself from torpor to end any combat that doesn't involve
her (and so on)?

2) I can't find the answer to this too: is it true that I can burn the
Masquer to give to one of my vamp a permanent +1 intercept, or is it just
for 1 action?

Many thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cartman wrote:
>
> 1)I read that the vamp special ability can be used even if the vamp is in
> torpor: is it true?

Card text of a card in play applies, yes.

> Can Mariel tap herself from torpor to end any combat that doesn't involve
> her (and so on)?

Yes.

> 2) I can't find the answer to this too: is it true that I can burn the
> Masquer to give to one of my vamp a permanent +1 intercept, or is it just
> for 1 action?

The latter.
